parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the pot to cover it.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to retain heat and moisture while cooking, preventing spillage and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move during cooking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the kitchen pot is a cylindrical container made of stainless steel with handles on the sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing the main volume for heat transfer from the stove.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during cooking but can be lifted or moved using the handles.
